facts.fact: A Tasdjil civil-registration kiosk, equipped with a solar kit, computer and photocopier, was handed over at the Moundou Adventist hospital on 8 April 2025 as the first of nine planned in health facilities.
The Tasdjil kiosks are financed by the EU-funded Programme d'Appui à la Gouvernance 2, in partnership with ANATS, per the hospital manager.
